name: dark
provenance: LiuCompare OWN design (docs/20 D5: dark theme in MVP; §3 P5: hue semantics inherited from the measured reference, lightness optimized). Every value below states its design rule. Geometry is NOT themed: row pitch/gutter/body x stay the measured colors.json lattice (BC layout knowledge, docs/20 §3: 布局参考). The hue anchors: different=red-dominant, similar=blue-dominant, hatch dots on the void side, radio selected=blue fill — same semantic families as extracted/live/textcolor-en/colors.json and filter-map.json; only luminance channels are ours.

pane_base.rule: dark surfaces ~28/255 (Fluent dark canvas family); the right pane keeps BC's subtle ~3/255 dimming direction (measured note in colors.json) as layout knowledge

ink.rule: light ink on dark base; measured ~12.9:1 / ~10.2:1 contrast vs pane base (WCAG AAA), right side keeps BC's lower-contrast-dimmer pairing direction

gutter.rule: gutter one step above pane base (BC direction: 240 on 252/255), digits grey ~4.8:1 vs gutter (WCAG AA)

same.rule: measured BC rule kept: same rows are the PLAIN pane base, no tint band

similar.rule: blue-dominant (B-R=36/33), dark family of BC's faint blue (238,238,255); light ink contrast ~9.4:1 (AAA)

different.rule: red-dominant (R-G=42/38), dark family of BC's light red (255,227,227); light ink contrast ~8.5:1

leftorphan.rule: content side red, empty side stays base (measured BC status pairing: tint on content, void hatch on opposite)

hatch.rule: void side = pane base + dot lattice (BC's mechanism, measured 8px period phase 7 kept as layout reference); stripes LIGHTER than base on dark surfaces; right stripe stronger (1.4:1 vs 2.6:1 against base, mirroring BC's measured asymmetry right-191/left-230 = stronger right stripe)

radio.rule: selected keeps BC's blue-fill semantics (measured 194,220,245) at dark luminance (ink-on-sel ~6.5:1, sel-vs-window ~2:1 = fill hue reads, not text contrast); unselected = gutter step; selection stays pixel-only like BC (UIA exposure = D3 provider work, not theme)

toolbar.rule: toolbar text-button face (docs/21 B tier-1): text = ink.left family on window_bg 30 (contrast ~12.9:1, WCAG AAA, same ink the diff panes use — one surface vocabulary); hover = gutter bg step (43, one step above base, the established 'one step up' direction); pressed one more step (53); divider 64 (reads against base at ~2:1, a hairline only). Same hue-neutral grey family as gutter/window — no new hue introduced.

scope_note: dark first cut themes the diff panes + filter radio strip + window base + toolbar text-button face (docs/21 B tier-1). Menu/Dialog skins (P1 Fluent skin) are follow-on work in the same Theme mechanism; until then menus keep WPF defaults.
